turns.text:
Our integration started getting this back after a burst of calls, what does it mean?

{"error":{"code":"ABDM-1022","message":"Too many requests"}}

must_contain: ABDM-1022 means you are sending more requests than ABDM accepts from your client, and it has started refusing them
NHA also publishes ABDM-2429 with the same meaning
the fix is to back off exponentially and add jitter rather than retrying immediately
notes: pasted form; response body is representative, not a recorded example for this code.
